sages.name: MELCHIOR
sages.notes: Claude Code headless. Prompt is piped via stdin. .result holds the final text. Headless denies network tools by default; WebSearch/WebFetch are allowlisted so research mode works. Keep this variadic flag last.

sages.name: BALTHASAR
sages.notes: Codex exec reads the prompt from stdin when '-' is given; final message goes to ANSWER_FILE. read-only sandbox: an opinion never needs to write files.

sages.name: CASPER
sages.notes: Grok Build headless. Prompt is passed as a file path. schema_args is appended when the host supplies a schema. permission-mode auto is required: without it tool use stalls on an approval prompt nobody can answer and the run ends with stopReason Cancelled.
